title: Hausdorff measure of balls in an n-plane
statement: Let N, n ∈ ℕ, T ∈ G(N,n) (Grassmannian N n) and r > 0. Let P = T.plane ⊆ ℝ^N, an n-dimensional linear subspace, and H^n = μHE[n] on ℝ^N = Euclidean N. Let B_r(0) = closedBall 0 r and B°_r(0) = ball 0 r. Let ω_n = unitBallVolume n, the Lebesgue measure of the open unit ball of ℝ^n = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n). Then H^n(P ∩ B_r(0)) = ω_n·r^n and H^n(P ∩ B°_r(0)) = ω_n·r^n in [0,∞]. Precisely, both equal unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal r ^ n.
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (T : Grassmannian N n) (r : ℝ), 0 < r → (μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N)) ((T.plane : Set (Euclidean N)) ∩ closedBall 0 r) = unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal r ^ n ∧ (μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N)) ((T.plane : Set (Euclidean N)) ∩ ball 0 r) = unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal r ^ n
